name: 追加調整付き飲料の選択行
prompt: Render ONE compact Japanese drink-option row LH19-0059 on pure white. Input1 ORIGINAL target x48,y399,w1083,h166 has highest priority for empty radio glyph roundness, stroke/opticalweight, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine details. Input2 MOCK secondary exact Japanese content/layout, not overbold glyphs. Input3 comparison originalLEFT/mockRIGHT. Input4 official style. Logical390px wide,84px high,16px padding. Left textblock: 抹茶シェイク（大） in MeiryoRegular14/24, below 追加料金の表示欄 in MeiryoRegular12/16, tracking0. Right a single unselected radio20px, white interior and slate#526173 outline matching ORIGINAL, centered vertically to textblock. Ink#1D1D1D and secondary#6E6E6E. White row/card with fine neutralborder#E4E7EB if needed, restrained tinyshadow, no mint/grayfill, no green selected state because it is UNSELECTED. Source adaptation intentionally replaces dollar amount with Japanese display-field text; do not invent a price or brand. No drink photo/other rows/header/phone/ID/annotation/actionfooter. Precise compact alignment and readable Apple-like hierarchy.
reviewNotes: 未選択slate radioとwhitecard/neutralborder、日本語2行は保持。先頭labelが指定Regular14より明確にBold寄りのためweight補正が必要。original fine-control優先、金額追加なし。native/font厳密一致、所有者承認/実装は未認定。
